name: SN2 inversion
description: SN2 substitution generally inverts configuration at the reacting stereocenter.

name: Mitsunobu inversion
description: Alcohol replacement commonly occurs with inversion.

name: Hydrogenation stereochemistry
description: Syn addition at a metal surface can influence relative stereochemistry.

name: Epimerization risk
description: Activated stereocenters can epimerize under suitable conditions.
